title: A Writer from a Small Town
text:
Anna Nowak was born in 1978 in a small town in Poland. Her father was a teacher, and her mother worked in a library. Anna loved to read books from a very young age.

When she was fifteen, Anna wrote her first short story. She sent it to a magazine, and they published it. Today she is a famous writer, and her books are read in many countries.

questions.text: How old was Anna when she wrote her first short story?
What can we infer about Anna's childhood?
options: She lived in a large city
Books were important in her family
She wanted to become a doctor

questions.text: How did the magazine publishing her story probably affect Anna?
options: It made her want to stop writing
It encouraged her to become a writer
It made her move to another country
It made her change her name

vocabulary.definition: a person whose job is to teach people, usually in a school
a place where people can borrow and read books
a thin publication with articles and pictures, printed regularly

paragraph_translations: Anna Nowak urodziła się w 1978 roku w małym miasteczku w Polsce. Jej ojciec był nauczycielem, a matka pracowała w bibliotece. Anna od bardzo młodego wieku lubiła czytać książki.
Kiedy miała piętnaście lat, Anna napisała swoje pierwsze opowiadanie. Wysłała je do czasopisma, a oni je opublikowali. Dziś jest sławną pisarką, a jej książki czyta się w wielu krajach.
